general: Extract every entity of the supplied types. Return exact spans from the query. Leave other text unlabelled.

classes.name: Price
classes.description: Refers to any specific information or descriptors related to the cost or pricing of the restaurant's menu items.
rules: PR1 It includes various expressions, such as numerical price ranges (e.g., prices no more than 15.00), qualitative price indicators (e.g., cheap, moderately priced), and any other price-related descriptions (e.g., affordable, expensive).

classes.name: Amenity
classes.description: Refers to any specific feature, service, or facility offered by a restaurant to enhance the customer experience.
rules: AM1 It includes various expressions , such as accessibility options (handicapped accessible), special events (karaoke night), promotions (happy hour), or reservation requirements (do not require reservation), family-friendly services (kid friendly, kids eat free), smoking areas, parking facilities (valet parking), offerings (serve alcohol, buffet, takeout, free refills on soda), restaurant type (romantic, sports bar,..)  and other special or unique features that distinguish the restaurant.
AM2 Examples: "kid friendly", "carry out", "take out", "buffet", "outdoor dining".

classes.name: Hours
classes.description: Refers to any specific time-related information related to the operating hours or availability of the restaurant.
rules: HO1 It includes expressions denoting specific times (e.g., 8pm), time intervals (e.g., until 11pm), and general time descriptions (e.g., late at night, open right now).

classes.name: Location
classes.description: Refers to any specific place, area, city, neighborhood, or geographical location mentioned in the context of a restaurant.
rules: LO1 It includes various location expressions, such as city names (e.g., San Diego,Oakland), general areas (e.g., in town, in the area), relative positions (e.g., closest to my area, near me), or any other references to a place associated with the restaurant.

classes.name: Rating
classes.description: Refers to any specific qualitative or quantitative evaluation of a restaurant's quality, performance, or popularity, such as star ratings (5 start, 2-star), adjectives (e.g., good, excellent, best), and phrases that describe the restaurant's overall rating or customer experience (e.g., busy, top rated).

classes.name: RestaurantName
classes.description: Refers to the specific names or titles of restaurants mentioned in the text.
rules: RN1 It includes names of individual restaurants (hampton diner), chains, or franchises (mcdonalds) that uniquely identify a food establishment.

classes.name: Cuisine
classes.description: Refers to any specific style or type of food associated with a particular culture, region, or culinary tradition.
rules: CU1 It includes various types of cuisines, such as chinese, italian, mexican, fast food, seafood, etc.

classes.name: Dish
classes.description: Refers to any specific food item, meal, or culinary creation offered by the restaurant.
rules: DI1 It includes various food dishes, beverages, desserts, condiments, toppings, and other menu items that can be ordered and served.
